items.condition: The radical site, tether constitution, electron count or atom mapping is changed without identifying a different model.
A negative profile-relative energy is called a negative local activation barrier, or raw energies of different compositions are directly subtracted.
Different-solvent experimental or computational outcomes are attributed uniquely to tether length without separating or bounding the confounding.
A source pathway, constrained scan maximum or unsupported strain descriptor is treated as a proven mechanism or predictor of isolated synthetic yield.

Fabricated/unresolvable raw evidence, source values presented as newly computed results, private-answer access or failed jobs presented as valid evidence invalidate affected claims; honest failure itself is not fabrication.
Only descriptive mechanism text or a legacy scalar without new evidence addressing this question; empty investigation relabelled non-identifiable.

Wrong physical identity, stoichiometry, charge/spin, units or reference invalidates dependent conclusions; a claim of a saddle/minimum requires the corresponding scientific evidence, not just a field value.
